pack.name: Clonedivers and EmpireDivers
pack.notes: Unified v2.0 Format-3 candidate combining Clonedivers r20 and EmpireDivers r48 across Full, Lighter, and Johnson Ultra-Potato (512px) texture tiers, All CIS / Mixed Bots + CIS / Native Automatons enemy skins, and Covenant 1670.
pack.statusNotes: All 54 selection combinations across EmpireDivers r48 (18) and Clonedivers r20 (36) passed verify_candidate.py.

textureProfiles.name: Lighter textures
textureProfiles.description: Full texture detail, streamed as needed.

textureProfiles.name: Johnson Ultra-Potato (512px)
textureProfiles.description: 512px texture cap for low-VRAM GPUs or slower asset streaming; softer distant textures, same meshes and audio.

options.name: Droid skins
options.description: Use CIS enemies, vehicles and structures. Enemy audio stays unchanged.

options.name: Mixed Bots + CIS Droids
options.description: Mix curated CIS battle droids with native Automaton heavy units and vehicles.

options.name: Walker weapons
options.description: Show original MTT cannons and spider-droid weapons. Does not add eye/vent markers or change hitboxes.

options.name: Covenant squids
options.description: Covenant models and voices for core Illuminate units. Newer units remain vanilla.

options.name: EmpireDivers
options.description: Imperial armor, Star Destroyers, gray LAAT, AT-STs and battle intro with the shared Clonedivers weapon and vehicle setup.
